title: Club Purchase Recognition on Northgate Optical Switch-Down Credits
content:
A Northgate Optical switch-down credit carries a spend bonus for members whose recent club purchases reach set levels. The purchases are read from the member's Northgate Purchases & Returns records.

**Net Northgate purchases.** The member's net Northgate purchases are the sale lines of the member's purchases dated less than twelve whole months before the day the credit is worked out, less the return lines of the member's purchases dated in the same months.

**Spend bonus.** Where those net Northgate purchases are at least 2500.00, a switch-down spend bonus of 5.00 is added, and where they are at least 750.00 but less than 2500.00, the spend bonus is 2.50. Net purchases below 750.00 carry no switch-down spend bonus.

## Levels

| Net Northgate purchases over the last twelve months (USD) | Switch-down spend bonus (USD) |
|---|---|
| below 750.00 | none |
| 750.00 up to but not including 2500.00 | 2.50 |
| 2500.00 or more | 5.00 |

## Examples (hypothetical members)

| Sale lines in the twelve months | Return lines in the same months | Net purchases | Spend bonus |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2810.40 | 310.40 | 2500.00 | 5.00 |
| 2810.40 | 310.41 | 2499.99 | 2.50 |
| 980.00 | 230.00 | 750.00 | 2.50 |
| 900.00 | 150.01 | 749.99 | none |

A sale line dated twelve whole months or more before the day the credit is worked out is outside the period, and so is a return line of that age.
